design_basis.adopted: 把屏幕元素结构化后再进行后续目标/任务处理；本轮将视觉观察与项目事实分成独立证据通道
视觉理解与文本知识检索分路后再合并；本轮仅允许纯视觉问题绕过文档证据门
把检索证据质量和生成回答质量分开诊断；本轮保持文档 evidence_gate 独立于视觉 evidence_gate

implemented.direct_visual_query: visual evidence may answer visible-screen questions without project documents
implemented.mixed_query_policy: visual evidence cannot bypass document evidence gate
implemented.missing_document_behavior: explain that visible content was recognized but project conclusion is not inferred; preserve visual evidence block

limits: The document-dependency classifier is deterministic and conservative; it is not a semantic entailment model
This prevents one known evidence bypass but does not prove answer truth, retrieval recall, or multimodal accuracy
Mixed-query marker coverage, real 30 episode evaluation, calibrated confidence, full-chain P50/P95, and sealed-test remain unfinished
